family: F-net-tls-strp: TLS strparser operating on stale skb after TCP skb compaction
root_cause: tls_strp_check_rcv()/tls_strp_msg_load path in net/tls/tls_strp.c keeps and dereferences a stale skb pointer (the TCP receive queue head) when checking decrypt state/geometry of queued skbs; after TCP coalesces/compacts skbs the cached skb is freed/changed, leading to a NULL/freed pointer dereference in softirq (tls_data_ready from tcp_data_queue).
fatal_mechanism: oops (NULL pointer dereference, address 0x28) in tls_strp_check_rcv from tls_data_ready <- tcp_data_queue <- tcp_rcv_established in softirq

fix_commits.subject: tls: always refresh the queue when reading sock
fix_commits.author: Jakub Kicinski

equivalent_fix_criteria: Patch re-reads the socket receive queue (skb_peek of sk_receive_queue) on every check instead of reusing the cached skb, i.e. the 4ab26bce3969 approach, or recommends backporting 4ab26bce3969/bdbdd06cb731.
confidence_note: Tier A-: fix is human-authored and its changelog names tls_strp_check_rcv, but no human confirmed the mapping for this MID; the crash kernel fbk10 (2025-06-18) predates the backport in fbk13.
